units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王说了一大套话，玉鬘一言不答，心中忐忑不安。

en.t: The Prince of Hyobukyo spoke at great length, but Tamakazura did not answer a single word, and her heart was filled with unease.

units.source_text: 此时源氏走近她身边，把帷屏上的一条垂布撩起。

en.t: Just then Genji came close beside her and lifted one of the hanging cloths from the screen curtain.

units.source_text: 同时周围忽然发出亮光。

en.t: At the same moment, a sudden brightness shone all around them.

units.source_text: 玉鬘以为拿出蜡烛来了，吃了一惊。

en.t: Tamakazura thought someone had brought out candles, and she was startled.

units.source_text: 原来源氏这一天傍晚将许多萤火虫用纸包好，藏在身边，不使光线透露出来。

en.t: It turned out that earlier that evening Genji had wrapped many fireflies in paper and hidden them near him so that no light would show through.

units.source_text: 此时他装作整理帷屏的样子，突然把萤火虫放出，因此周围忽然大放光明。

en.t: Now, pretending to straighten the screen curtain, he suddenly released the fireflies, and the whole area at once filled with bright light.

units.source_text: 玉鬘讨厌之极，连忙拿扇子遮住面孔，那侧影异常美丽。

en.t: Tamakazura was deeply displeased and hurriedly covered her face with a fan, yet her profile was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏玩这把戏，有个用意：突然大放光明，兵部卿亲王便可窥见玉鬘的容貌。

en.t: Genji had a purpose in playing this trick: when the sudden brightness flared, the Prince of Hyobukyo would be able to glimpse Tamakazura's face.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王之所以如此热诚地求爱，

en.t: The reason the Prince of Hyobukyo was courting her with such ardor

units.source_text: 只是为了她是源氏的女儿之故，却并未料到她的品质容貌如此十全其美。

en.t: was merely that she was Genji's daughter; he had not imagined that both her character and her beauty would be so utterly perfect.

units.source_text: 现在让他看看，好教这个急色儿恼煞，因此他做这般布置。

en.t: Genji arranged things this way so that the eager lover might see her now and be tormented all the more.

units.source_text: 如果玉鬘确是他的亲生女儿，料想他不会如此胡闹。

en.t: If Tamakazura had truly been his own daughter, one imagines he would not have behaved so recklessly.

units.source_text: 他这用心实在太无聊了。

en.t: His intention in this was really far too frivolous.

units.source_text: 他放出萤火虫之后，便从另一扇门里溜出，回自邸去了。

en.t: After releasing the fireflies, he slipped out through another door and returned to his own residence.
